title: US Health Insurance Benefits Summary
text:
# US Health Insurance Benefits Summary
**Region:** United States
**Effective Date:** January 1, 2024
**Document ID:** HR-POL-US-021

## Plan Options
- PPO Gold Plan: $150/month employee premium, $500 individual deductible.
- PPO Silver Plan: $90/month employee premium, $1,500 individual deductible.
- HDHP + HSA Plan: $40/month employee premium, $3,200 individual deductible,
  Company contributes $1,000/year to employee HSA.

## Eligibility
Full-time employees (30+ hours/week) are eligible from day 1 of employment.
Part-time employees are not eligible for Company-subsidized health plans.

## Dependent Coverage
Spouses, domestic partners, and dependent children up to age 26 may be
added during open enrollment or within 30 days of a qualifying life event
(marriage, birth, adoption, loss of other coverage).

## Open Enrollment
Held annually in November for coverage effective January 1. Changes outside
open enrollment require a qualifying life event and must be reported to
HR within 30 days of the event.

## Contact
Benefits Team - hr-benefits@company.com | 1-800-555-0142

title: EU Parental Leave Policy
text:
# EU Parental Leave Policy
**Region:** European Union (Germany, France, Netherlands offices)
**Effective Date:** January 1, 2022
**Document ID:** HR-POL-EU-014

## Overview
This policy applies to all full-time employees based in EU member-state
offices, in addition to statutory parental leave entitlements provided by
local law, whichever is more generous to the employee.

## Eligibility
All full-time employees are eligible from their first day of employment,
consistent with EU Directive 2019/1158 on work-life balance for parents.

## Leave Entitlement
- Birthing parent: 16 weeks fully paid leave, plus any additional statutory
  maternity leave required by local law.
- Non-birthing parent / secondary caregiver: 10 weeks fully paid leave.
- Leave may be taken within 12 months of the qualifying event, or as
  otherwise permitted by local statutory law.

## Pay During Leave
100% of base salary, coordinated with statutory maternity/parental pay
schemes to avoid double payment.

## How to Apply
Submit local country HR leave form (see country-specific intranet page)
at least 60 days before the anticipated start date, in accordance with
local statutory notice requirements.

## Contact
EU HR Benefits Team - hr-benefits-eu@company.com

title: US Parental Leave Policy
text:
# US Parental Leave Policy
**Region:** United States
**Effective Date:** January 1, 2021
**Document ID:** HR-POL-US-014 (v1.0)
**Status:** Archived - superseded by HR-POL-US-014 (v2.0), effective March 1, 2023

## Overview
This policy applies to all full-time employees based in the United States.

## Eligibility
Employees must have completed at least 90 days of continuous employment prior
to the expected date of birth, adoption, or foster placement.

## Leave Entitlement
- Birthing parent: 8 weeks of fully paid leave.
- Non-birthing parent / secondary caregiver: 4 weeks of fully paid leave.
- Leave must be taken within 6 months of the qualifying event.

## Pay During Leave
100% of base salary is paid during the leave period through the Company's
short-term disability and parental leave benefit program. Leave does not
count against the employee's standard PTO balance.

## How to Apply
Submit Form HR-014 to your manager and to hr-leaves@company.com at least
30 days before the anticipated start date (or as soon as practicable for
unplanned events such as premature birth).

## Contact
HR Benefits Team - hr-benefits@company.com

title: US Parental Leave Policy - 2023 Amendment
text:
# US Parental Leave Policy - 2023 Amendment
**Region:** United States
**Effective Date:** March 1, 2023
**Document ID:** HR-POL-US-014 (v2.0) - SUPERSEDES v1.0

## Summary of Changes
Effective March 1, 2023, the Company has expanded parental leave benefits
for all US-based full-time employees. This amendment supersedes and replaces
the parental leave terms described in HR-POL-US-014 (v1.0, dated Jan 1, 2021)
in their entirety.

## Eligibility
Employees must have completed at least 60 days of continuous employment
(reduced from 90 days) prior to the qualifying event.

## Leave Entitlement
- Birthing parent: 12 weeks of fully paid leave (increased from 8 weeks).
- Non-birthing parent / secondary caregiver: 8 weeks of fully paid leave
  (increased from 4 weeks).
- Leave must be taken within 12 months of the qualifying event (increased
  from 6 months).

## Pay During Leave
100% of base salary, unchanged from prior policy. Leave does not count
against standard PTO balance.

## How to Apply
Same process as before: submit Form HR-014 to your manager and to
hr-leaves@company.com at least 30 days before the anticipated start date.

## Contact
HR Benefits Team - hr-benefits@company.com

title: US Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy
text:
# US Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy
**Region:** United States
**Effective Date:** January 1, 2024
**Document ID:** HR-POL-US-007

## Overview
Applies to all full-time, non-union US employees.

## Accrual
- Years 0-2 of service: 15 PTO days/year, accrued at 1.25 days/month.
- Years 3-5 of service: 20 PTO days/year, accrued at 1.67 days/month.
- Years 6+ of service: 25 PTO days/year, accrued at 2.08 days/month.

## Carryover
Up to 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the next calendar year.
Any balance above 5 days is forfeited on December 31, unless local state
law requires otherwise (e.g., California does not permit "use-it-or-lose-it"
policies; unused PTO carries over in full for CA-based employees).

## Requesting PTO
Submit requests through the WorkdayHR portal at least 5 business days in
advance for planned absences. Manager approval is required.

## Payout on Termination
Unused, accrued PTO is paid out at the employee's final base rate upon
termination, in accordance with state law.

## Contact
HR Benefits Team - hr-benefits@company.com

title: Global Remote & Hybrid Work Policy
text:
# Global Remote & Hybrid Work Policy
**Region:** Global (all offices)
**Effective Date:** June 1, 2023
**Document ID:** HR-POL-GLOBAL-030

## Work Arrangements
- **Hybrid** (default): Minimum 3 days/week in the assigned office.
- **Full Remote**: Requires Director-level approval and is only available
  for roles explicitly designated "remote-eligible" by the role's job code.
- **Full-Time Office**: Required for roles that handle physical records,
  regulated healthcare data on-site, or lab/clinical work.

## Equipment
Company provides a laptop, monitor, and a one-time $300 home-office stipend
for approved full-remote employees. Hybrid employees are not eligible for
the home-office stipend.

## Cross-Border Remote Work
Employees may not work remotely from a country other than their country of
employment for more than 20 consecutive business days without prior approval
from HR and Legal, due to tax and labor law implications.

## Review Cadence
Manager and employee review the work arrangement every 6 months.

## Contact
Workplace Experience Team - workplace@company.com
